principal_open.condition: det(P) != 0 in P0, where P columns are secondary coords of η^k
principal_open.integral_model: P has constant (integer) denominators only; clear by lcm of dens_P
principal_open.note: Good-prime/specialization nonzero det proves det P not identically zero; does not replace exact basis maps

minimal_polynomial.definition: m_η(T) = det(T I - L_η) = charpoly(L_η) (monic in P0[T])
minimal_polynomial.degree_proof: power basis {1,η,...,η^{11}} is P0-linearly independent on the principal open det P != 0, hence [P0(η):P0]=12 and m_η has degree 12

maps.multiplication: convert to secondary, use G3A structure constants, convert back

agreement_with_field_api.trace_norm_inverse: delegated to field_api on secondary model; power basis transport via P
